cases.requirement: UDP header and payload length must be representable within the received IPv4 datagram; UDP checksum validation is required when present, and checksum zero is legal for IPv4. Exact-buffer safety and recovery are selected robustness properties.

cases.applicability: ESTABLISHED, original receive capacity, S=00000000

cases.gaps: Finite ownership regression; queue retention is optional. No capacity override. PROFILE denotes a robustness contract, not an uppercase RFC MUST.
